subject: Vendor onboarding kickoff: evidence bundle & PO intake
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@oakmonthealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@oakmonthealth.com
Date: 2026-11-16T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding kickoff & compliance prerequisites

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for taking the time to get Oakmont set up with Redwood. We are kicking off vendor setup for the upcoming contract and need to collect a small evidence bundle before we can route the PO to approvals. Can you share the following items as part of the initial intake?

- Current SOC 2 Type II report (redacted acceptable)
- ISO 27001 certificate or equivalent
- Penetration test attestation / letter from a qualified 3rd party
- Completed vendor setup worksheet (I attached our standard form)
- W9 (for US vendors)
- Confirmation of billing remit-to and PO process (who to send PO to, invoice cadence, payment terms)

Target internal timeline is: receipt of items by 2026-11-24 so we can secure a PO by early Dec. If you anticipate any gaps, please tell us which items will be delayed and any expected delivery dates.

Also — Oakmont requires a DPA (data processing addendum) and a pen-test attestation signed by a security officer; we can share our template if helpful.

Appreciate a quick ack and ETA.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Vendor Manager | Oakmont Health
Samantha.Lee@oakmonthealth.com
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-11-17T10:03:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding kickoff & compliance prerequisites

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear list and timeline. We can provide everything you requested; see status below and next steps.

Quick status:
- SOC 2 Type II: we will provide a redacted report (attestation + scope summary) by EOD 2026-11-23.
- ISO 27001: certificate copy attached (current cert is in place).
- Pen test attestation: we have an attestation letter from our vendor; I'll attach the signed letter.
- Vendor setup worksheet: attaching our completed worksheet (Vendor-Setup-Worksheet.xlsx) — please confirm if you need additional fields.
- W9: attached.

PO / invoicing: our billing team prefers to receive the PO to billing@redwood.ai. Standard terms are Net30 unless a different term is negotiated by contracts. We accept invoices monthly, with remit-to provided on the invoice. If Oakmont requires vendor portal onboarding, we can participate — please share the portal link.

I’m looping in Marcus (finance lead) and Laura (contracting) to address any billing or contract questions.

Next: Marcus will confirm billing remit details and Laura will coordinate contract/DPA language if Oakmont sends a draft.

Thanks — we’ll upload the redacted SOC 2 to the Drive link and share the DocuSign envelope if you prefer signed attestation on the pen test.

Regards,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
T: +1 415-555-0117

Attachments: Vendor-Setup-Worksheet.xlsx, ISO27001-cert-2025.pdf, W9-Redwood-Inference.pdf
